assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and presyncope.
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency corresponds to diagnosis code I34.0.
The patient has unspecified cardiac arrhythmia.
Unspecified cardiac arrhythmia corresponds to diagnosis code I49.9.
The symptoms are intermittent in nature.
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is the service at issue.
The long-term continuous ECG monitoring service is billed under CPT 93247.
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of collapse.
The service is necessary to correlate clinical events with underlying rhythm disturbances.
The correlation of clinical events with rhythm disturbances is described in the clinical indication note.
